title: 법원통계규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Management of Statistical Data Related to Judicial Affairs)
(1) Persons responsible for entering data into the judicial affairs information systems of courts at each level shall take care to ensure that statistical data contain no errors or omissions when entering data.
(2) Courts at each level shall review the statistical data in their judicial affairs information systems every month as prescribed by the Court Statistics Directives. Where any erroneous or omitted item is found, they shall immediately correct the relevant item in the system and report the result of the correction to the Director of the National Court Administration.
(3) Courts at each level shall immediately comply with instructions to correct statistical data in their judicial affairs information systems that are issued by the National Court Administration following its periodic inspection of statistical data.
